Method of Attack: Process injection technique that bypasses EDR and other security products by using legitimate DLLs with RWX sections to evade EDR hooks and inject code into remote processes without using commonly abused Windows API calls, setting special permissions, performing memory allocation, or starting threads
Uses vulnerable DLL msys-2.0.dll with default RWX section to load malicious code
Two injection methods: self-injection via custom application nightmare.exe loading DLL into its memory space, and remote process injection into ssh.exe process
Abuses NTDLL.DLL for syscall extraction to bypass EDR hooks using Hell's Gate EDR unhooking technique
Injected shellcode loads MyLibrary.dll to establish reverse shell
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Visual Studio 2022 Community (due to msys-2.0.dll)
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious code into RWX section of vulnerable DLL msys-2.0.dll
Launching and injecting into child process ssh.exe
Bypassing EDR hooks without creating threads or allocating memory
